answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that only unlocks after peers attest its work over several epochs. A yarrow in a field looks identical to the next, but a deposit makes each copy expensive: spinning up a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes. Honest agents earn their stake back with interest, while a sybil swarm that never does real work bleeds its deposits dry. Like an echo that fades unless a real voice keeps speaking, cheap copies cannot sustain themselves, and the nebula of look-alike accounts collapses into a handful of verifiable actors.
